warnings: All bars are printed with Ø → type RB (spec §0.6 / §6). No concrete strength or steel grade is printed anywhere in the set; S-07 refers rebar details to 'หนังสือมาตรฐานประกอบแบบก่อสร้าง', which is not part of this set.

F1 1.30 x 1.30 on 9 piles (3 x 3), F2 1.30 x 1.80 on 12 piles (3 x 4); both 0.25 thick on 0.05 lean concrete 1:3:5 and 0.10 coarse sand, underside 1.20 below ระดับดินเดิม. The mats are printed by spacing only (Ø9 @0.10# / Ø12 @0.15#) — main_bar carries spacing_mm and no count (spec §6b).

C1 has two sections by height (one entry per level, spec §8): 0.25 x 0.25 from the footing to the floor beams (cover 2") and 0.20 x 0.20 from the floor beams to the roof (cover 1"), both 4-Ø12 with ties Ø6 @0.15. Covers are printed in inches and converted to mm.
